specification: Stage 2 development elimination and survivor selection rules

elimination_conditions.condition: baseline lift is nonpositive at both 60 and 120 minutes
elimination_conditions.label: FAIL

elimination_conditions.condition: favorable-first metrics fail to beat matched random at both primary horizons
elimination_conditions.label: FAIL

elimination_conditions.condition: adverse-tail MAE is materially worse without favorable-excursion benefit
elimination_conditions.label: FAIL

elimination_conditions.condition: nearly all support comes from one direction
elimination_conditions.label: FAIL

elimination_conditions.condition: nearly all support comes from one year or small cluster of sessions
elimination_conditions.label: FAIL

elimination_conditions.condition: isolated parameter spike with unsupported neighbours
elimination_conditions.label: FAIL

elimination_conditions.condition: configuration is clearly dominated on multiple pareto dimensions
elimination_conditions.label: FAIL

retention_rule: retain credible neighbouring cells around leading regions where those neighbours are not clearly dominated
supporting_summary: robust median ranks across locked primary metrics as supporting summary only
forbidden_actions: use one opaque scalar score as sole selector
select winner by whichever horizon looks best later
change Stage 1 signal or label semantics
add TP, SL, BE, trailing, sizing, costs or trade management
